adaptation_note: low ordinary early is rep2 from checkpoint1; adaptation state of one session, not a new patient

arms.MATCHED: 1.3x original baseline nominal segment durations on 5ms grid, fixed for baseline and candidates; only same segment counts and each phase residual<=25ms rank in isolated search; valid timing-confounded records remain separate
arms.NATIVE: unchanged closed-loop scheduler, safety, governor, RSS; force gains may include timing

fixed_best_rule: After search choose one tested descriptor maximizing valid/rankable coverage then mean fractional benefit across all ten condition-arm rows, missing treated as minus infinity; re-execute across all rows; in-sample teacher comparison only

fixed_pattern_preregistered.meaning: prior 40.628N s H3 hip-leading pattern, same path under each arm

individual_failures: preserve infeasible, invalid, exception, timeout; continue individual failures; do not alter safety

method_source.limitation: finite small populations do not prove convergence/global optimum
method_source.title: Sample-efficient Cross-Entropy Method for Real-time Planning
method_source.used: elite memory/sampling guidance only; this offline optimizer is simplified diagonal CEM

optimizer.algorithm: smoothed diagonal CEM with elite retention; CEM-style, no claim of full iCEM replication
optimizer.sampling: bounded proposal-domain Gaussian via rejection; fixed seeds; full existing feasibility/safety screens decide legality, no hidden physical truth; level warm-starts from confirmed rankable incumbent where representable

parameterization: L1 signed hip lead and knee lag, lead peak and width, separate RETURN amounts; L2 early/middle/late relative offsets per phase; L3 four additional smooth basis control coefficients per phase, normalized progress; nested endpoint-zero paths; original terminal endpoints unchanged
phase_A_gate: All ten original baseline pairs VALID, replay J_F error<=1e-6, reproduce historical baselines<=1e-6; fixed known-good matched sync and variable improve, safe random candidate outcomes recorded; no exceptions from systemic implementation defects
primary: J_F_task = integral norm(physical measured cuff force) dt, OUTBOUND+HOLD+RETURN, frozen 5ms left quadrature
safety: Production controller mathematics, Human dynamics, planner objective, safety thresholds and Scientific Mode semantics unchanged; inherited _evaluate and exact fixed-duration causal offset certificate unchanged
split: All selected previously-used conditions are search/development teacher-generation rows; no fresh held-out or population generalization claim
stop: baseline gate failure; protected fingerprint change; >6 bounded logging/search/serialization repairs; repeated infra failure; wall cap; no RL/training
storage: Losslessly gzip raw JSON logs, retain SHA256 of uncompressed and stored content, verify after compression; never delete historical data
truth_firewall: Candidate proposals use only condition/task id, frozen nominal baseline path and parameters. No online hidden truth. Physical case/Human state stored only as reproduction metadata; actual evaluation-only path is a diagnostic never replayed.
